betaNotes:
1.3.0 (48) — direct web preview, restored learning drafts and source-safety audit.

React + Gin study board: Run checks the Go routes; Output > Build & Preview installs from the bundled offline catalog and builds React without terminal commands. Open full screen, reload, or share the project archive. Static site previews also offer Open in Browser and Share local address. A loopback link works only on its current device; isolated React origins stay inside the app. No public publishing service, full npm/Node/Bun runtime or new network capability is added.

Lessons restore editable drafts after leaving/relaunch, including your own code before inserting a solution. Reset is explicit; content changes and save failures are reported. Assistance is recorded separately from compiler evidence. Course and unit pages offer direct Practice/Lab access. Existing progress and Continue IDs are retained. Worked readings keep the full explanation while their prompts are shorter; JSON and Unicode wording is corrected.

Library: existing Files folders open without overwrite. Switching flushes current work; unreadable bookmarks and missing known files fail visibly rather than substituting the on-device library. Coordinated writes retain conflicting versions and bounded backups. A physical iPhone A/B local Files-library edit/switch/process-relaunch test passed in a separate QA bundle. Remote iCloud synchronization and arbitrary third-party providers are not certified.

Source ownership guards prevent stale idiom changes and dependency publication into another project or newer source. Unsupported terminal flags, targets, arguments and shell syntax fail explicitly. GitHub imports pin an exact commit and show retained/omitted paths. Binary assets and full Git history remain outside this text snapshot.

Ordinary Go Run still has no guaranteed CPU deadline/tight-loop Stop or aggregate guest-write quota; memory/output limits and debugger checkpoint limits are documented. Prior offline frontend, explicit local Gin replay and source-debugger features remain.

Verification: 45 focused model/UI checks, 5 final ownership checks, the physical Files return flow, plus 34 earlier learning-return checks. No complete-suite or physical airplane-mode claim.
